title: Guardians beat White Sox 2-0 to reach next round
title_zh: 守护者队2比0击败白袜队，晋级下一轮

image.credit: Photo by Diego Corona on Unsplash
image.author: Diego Corona

lead: The Cleveland Guardians won a big baseball game on Saturday. They beat the Chicago White Sox 2-0. Now they play the Tampa Bay Rays.
lead_zh: 克利夫兰守护者队周六赢了一场重要的棒球比赛。他们2比0击败芝加哥白袜队。现在他们将迎战坦帕湾光芒队。

title_original: Williams strikes out 12 as Guardians blank White Sox to complete ALDS comeback
summary_original:
Williams fans 12 as Cleveland win decisive Game 5
Ramírez’s two-run homer provides only scoring
Guardians to face Rays for place in World Series
Gavin Williams struck out 12, José Ramírez homered on a pitch just above home plate and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Chicago White Sox 2-0 on Saturday night to complete a comeback from a 2-0 deficit in their best-of-five American League Division Series.
Cleveland open the American League Championship Series at Tampa Bay on Monday night, seeking their first World Series appearance since 2016. The Guardians/Indians franchise have not won the title since 1948, the longest drought among MLB teams.

Guardians to face Rays for place in World Series
Gavin Williams struck out 12, José Ramírez homered on a pitch just above home plate and the
Cleveland Guardians
beat the Chicago White Sox 2-0 on Saturday night to complete a comeback from a 2-0 deficit in their best-of-five American League Division Series.
Cleveland open the American League Championship Series at Tampa Bay on Monday night, seeking their first World Series appearance since 2016. The Guardians/Indians franchise have not won the title since 1948, the longest drought among
MLB
teams.
Guardians pitchers struck out 21, the most in a nine-inning postseason game. The White Sox managed just three hits, putting only nine balls in play, and struck out 75 times over the series.
Two days after getting the save in Game 4, Williams became just the third pitcher in postseason history to get the last out of a game and start the following game when his team faced elimination in both.
He did not allow a hit until Kyle Teel looped a knuckle-curve into right field with two outs in the sixth, two innings after Ramírez homered for the second straight game, a two-run drive off Sean Burke.
After a walk loaded the bases, Erik Sabrowski relieved Williams and struck out Munetaka Murakami.
Williams’s 12 strikeouts tied Cleveland’s record for a postseason game. He got 22 swings and misses, and his 24 strikeouts over three games tied for the second most in a best-of-five postseason series.
Hunter Gaddis followed Sabrowski and got four outs. Cade Smith finished for his first career five-out save, striking out the side in the ninth. He blew a fastball by Tristan Peters for the final out, setting off a celebration at Progressive Field.
Chicago, the first team to reach the playoffs after three straight 100-loss seasons, have not won the World Series since 2005.
